ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-3,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District and M1-1, Limited
Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 26-
F and Map No. 28-F in the area bound by:

West 108th Place; a line 61.80 feet east and parallel to the alley next east of and parallel to the
Union Pacific Railroad; the alley next south of and parallel to West 108th Place; a line 50.00 feet
east of and parallel to the alley next east of and parallel to Union Pacific Railroad; West 109th
Place; the alley next east of and parallel to Union Pacific Railroad; the alley next south of and
parallel to West 109th Place and extended where no street exists; a line 34.00 feet west of and
parallel to the alley; next west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; West 110th Street; the
alley next west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to
West 110th Street; a line 475.00 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; West
110th Place; the alley next west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; the alley next north
of and parallel to West 111th Street; a line 175 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton
Avenue; West 111" Street; a line 312.50 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue;
the alley next south of and parallel to West 111th Street; a line 325.00 feet west of and parallel
to South Princeton Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 111th Place; a line
368.75 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; West 112th Street; a line 309.00
feet west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West
112th Street; a line 262.50 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; West 112th
Place; and South Princeton Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its pa e and publication.

Ronnie L. Mosley
Alderman, 21°* Ward
